notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.notes: A small update today, that should fix a rare crash that occured when the game was not able to open the bones file. Also a new check to prevent random commander names from being generated that are too long.

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
I've uploaded a minor update to the game, in hopes of fixing a CTD with the following message:

"could not find any library for SDL2 (PYDSL2_DLL_PATH: unset)"

This update is compatible with saved campaigns from previous versions, the only change is the the directory of the SDL library is now explicity set during boot-up. You may have to restart Steam for it to download and apply the update.

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes: Armoured Commander has been updated to version 1.06, which now uses Python 3 and SDL 2. Please do report any bugs or crashes in the discussion boards, as there still might be a few elements that need to be updated.
